definitions.near_trap: Chebyshev <= 1 to any trap(g) [frozen]; Manhattan <= 1 = sensitivity only
definitions.route: greedy descent on builder.distances(free, g); first of builder.neighbors (= lexicographic-min shortest path)
definitions.trap: walkable c != T; every walkable 4-neighbour n: d(n,T) > d(c,T)
definitions.turn_away: step k with d(path[k+1], g) > d(path[k], g)
